question: D. E. Shaw SMTS Frontend (experienced), reported coding questions across rounds: **implement `Promise.all`** (and a Promise polyfill), plus **`useDebounce` and `useThrottle` hooks** and an **infinite scroll**. No source text was available beyond this summary, so this write-up focuses on the `Promise.all` implementation and briefly covers the related items.
lookingFor: Deep understanding of promise semantics and the event loop.
Correct handling of order, non-promise values, empty input and rejection.
Clean implementation without relying on the built-in `Promise.all`.
Ability to extend to related utilities (debounce, throttle, infinite scroll).
followUps: How would you implement Promise.allSettled, Promise.race and Promise.any?
What is the difference between microtasks and macrotasks in the event loop?
How would you limit concurrency to N parallel promises?
Why do debounce and throttle differ, and which would you use for a search box versus a scroll handler?
